course.title: Free trial: Learn Spanish through stories
course.description: Understand your first three Spanish stories in 30 minutes — no grammar drills. A taste of TPRS, the method behind every SpanishNow course.

unit.title: Your first Spanish stories
unit.description: Each story introduces just three new structures. You see them first, then hear and read the story in short scenes, answering easy questions along the way. Those questions are the method: many meaningful repetitions, so the words stick without memorizing.
